scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/synth-eval/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/scanner/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/detection/tsconfig.check.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/evidence/tsconfig.check.json
scripts.build:scanner: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/synth-eval && npm run build -w packages/scanner && npm run build -w packages/detection
